baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparative construction makes the human call for evil in the same manner as the call for good, then predicates haste of the human.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling inclines an outcome toward the speaker through words; evil and beneficial good occupy the same syntactic channel, while haste advances the request before its consequences have ripened. The temporal predicate turns the confusion into a recurrent human disposition rather than an isolated slip.

activation_trace.role: Verbal calling and inclination supplies the common action applied to both opposed objects.
Evil and harm supply the negative value that the common calling mechanism fails to screen out.
Beneficial good supplies the positive value against which the harmful request is explicitly measured.
Occurrence and presence in time make haste a persisting temporal condition.
Speed and advancement before the proper time provide the mechanism that collapses evaluation into immediacy.

changed_reading.before: A person may rashly pray for something harmful just as readily as for benefit.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagnoses a timing-driven failure of valuation: desire is verbalized before consequences mature, so one calling mechanism can misclassify harm as benefit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated call, its harmful object, and the final predicate of haste can be read as an initiating sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A hasty utterance is not only a mistaken wish. The call can be imaged as one fall drawing another after it, while evil is a flying spark; speed removes the interval in which the chain could be interrupted.

activation_trace.role: Successive collapse turns the call into the first link of a propagating sequence.
A flying fire-spark supplies the small released event from which wider harm can spread.
Premature speed removes the pause between ignition and propagation.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an ill-chosen request.
changed_reading.after: The request is an initiating event: a quickly released word can spark a serial collapse whose later stages were absent from the caller's evaluation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly supplies shown signs, visibility, counting, and articulated detail. Because the focus inventory also lets the human root carry seeing, hearing, and sensing, haste can be read as an epistemic ordering error: petition precedes inspection and differentiation.

activation_trace.role: Perceiving by sight, hearing, or inward sensing makes the human agent an evaluator, not merely a desiring body.
Advancement before the proper time places the request ahead of adequate perception.
Causing something to be seen supplies disclosure as the prerequisite the hasty caller bypasses.
A manifest sign supplies observable evidence against which good and evil could be distinguished.
Visual apprehension makes the day-side of the sequence a field for informed seeking.
Counting and reckoning supply the temporal calculation missing from premature desire.
Detailing parts and meanings supplies the discriminating operation that haste compresses.

structural_cues: The opening movement is ordered toward being shown signs, while 17:12 makes alternating night and day serve seeking, counting, and detailed articulation.
The focus sits between a warning about a deferred outcome and a verse devoted to temporal visibility and calculation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perception, signs, reckoning, detail, and the focus predicate of haste; I infer the arrow from insufficient inspection to misvalued petition. A live alternative is that these signs orient conduct generally without describing the cognition behind the focus call.

changed_reading.before: Haste is mainly excessive speed in wanting.
changed_reading.after: Haste is also a sequence error in knowing: the human calls before seeing, counting, and separating enough to tell apparent good from actual harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier context turns isolated action into recurrence: an event happens twice, advantage is returned, the turn recurs, and good or harm is directed to the same self before the formula 'if you return, We return.' The focus call therefore enters a reflexive cycle rather than departing harmlessly from the speaker.

activation_trace.role: One stage falling after another supplies the focus-side propagation that recurrence amplifies.
A temporal occurrence and repetition establish that the surrounding mechanism is iterative.
Return to a prior position supplies the reversal by which an apparent endpoint becomes another beginning.
Return and reiteration after a first occurrence make recurrence explicit.
Doing good supplies the positive action whose benefit is grammatically redirected to its agents.
The very self or entity supplies the receiver to whom both sides of the moral contrast return.
What causes hurt supplies the negative action and effect redirected toward that same self.
Return after departure, repeated in both condition and answer, closes the feedback loop.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from 'twice' in 17:4 through returned advantage in 17:6 to matched good and harm in 17:7 and the doubled return formula in 17:8.
The parallel clauses in 17:7 give positive and negative action the same self-directed grammar, echoing the focus comparison between calling for evil and calling for good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence, reversal, and self-directed moral symmetry; I infer that the focus utterance participates in that feedback structure. The live alternative is that 17:4-8 remains a collective historical cycle and does not specify the causal path of each individual call.

changed_reading.before: A hasty utterance can start a one-way harmful chain.
changed_reading.after: The utterance is dangerous because the chain is recursive and reflexive: what is called and enacted can return through repeated turns to the same human who misnamed it as good.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, the context gives good a procedural test: gentle direction toward a path, upright alignment, fitting action, and resulting recompense. This revises 'good' from whatever attracts a request into a criterion that desire must answer to.

activation_trace.role: Verbal inclination supplies the desire-driven motion whose object needs an external criterion.
Choosing and seeking the better option pose the question of how the caller identifies what is actually good.
Gentle indication toward the right path supplies a criterion beyond immediate attraction.
Straightness, balance, and uprightness define the alignment by which a desired object can be tested.
Purposive work shifts the positive course from wish alone to enacted pursuit.
Fitness and suitability supply a relational test for whether an action truly belongs to the good.
Recompense after work supplies an outcome structurally different from immediate acquisition.

structural_cues: The clause sequence in 17:9 moves from guidance to the most upright course, then to belief, fitting work, and recompense.
The focus follows after 17:10 adds the deferred horizon that some agents reject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a guided and enacted path adjacent to the focus; I infer that it functions as the test the hasty caller omits when naming an object good. A live alternative is that 17:9 promises an outcome without defining the focus term 'good.'

changed_reading.before: Good is the beneficial object the human intends to request.
changed_reading.after: Good is not secured by intensity of wanting; it is a guided, upright, fitting course with an outcome, while haste substitutes attraction for that criterion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context names rejection of the later horizon just before the focus, then reuses the haste root for desiring 'the immediate' and contrasts it with willing the later horizon through its due striving. Haste is therefore not only tempo but a horizon-selection rule that rates fast arrival above terminal consequence.

activation_trace.role: Calling and verbal inclination provide the act whose object is selected under a temporal horizon.
Speed and advancement before due time provide the focus diagnosis that the later context lexicalizes.
Deferral to a later time supplies the horizon excluded immediately before the focus.
Painful punishment supplies the delayed negative consequence absent from an immediate valuation.
The immediate object and its acceleration make the focus predicate into an explicit temporal economy.
Will and intention distinguish the human demand for immediacy from the selective will governing what is accelerated.
Encounter with fire supplies the terminal consequence hidden by the near-term object.
The later horizon supplies the explicit counterpart to the immediate.
Purposeful motion toward a sought end replaces instant petition with sustained trajectory.
Acknowledged and commended effort supplies the positive valuation reached at the end of the deferred path.

structural_cues: The focus is immediately preceded by nonbelief in the later horizon and its painful consequence.
Verses 17:18-19 form parallel conditional alternatives: desire for the immediate and accelerated allotment versus desire for the later horizon and its corresponding striving.
The repeated haste root in 17:18 is the clearest lexical return to the focus predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the immediate/later contrast, repeated haste root, selective acceleration, and purposeful striving; I infer that arrival speed is the hidden metric by which the focus human mistakes evil for good. A live alternative is that the focus haste describes rash speech more narrowly, while 17:18 classifies life aims.

changed_reading.before: The human is impulsive within a single request.
changed_reading.after: The human adopts immediacy as a value horizon: what arrives quickly is treated as good even when its terminal path is harmful, whereas the later good requires sustained directed effort.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context converts what appears transient into what adheres, is written, spread open, read, and reckoned by the self. Applied to the focus, a hasty call does not vanish when voiced; it becomes inspectable material within the caller's own account.

activation_trace.role: Voiced calling supplies the apparently transient event that the context refigures as durable evidence.
Affixing something by obligation makes consequence inseparable from its human bearer.
Joined letters and the written object supply durable, legible form.
The spread-open writing supplies later exposure of what had seemed finished.
Reading and recitation turn the durable trace back into addressed language.
The self as the thing itself supplies both bearer and witness of the trace.
Counting and accounting supply the evaluative return of the recorded act.

structural_cues: Verses 17:13-14 move in sequence from attachment to a book, its open presentation, an imperative to read, and self-accounting.
The repeated human noun links the focus agent directly to the bearer of the attached account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attachment, book, opening, reading, and self-reckoning; I infer that the focus call belongs among the acts made durable. A live alternative is that the book covers deeds broadly and the packet does not isolate petitions as its entries.

changed_reading.before: The hasty call is a fleeting verbal mistake.
changed_reading.after: The call can be carried as durable self-evidence: speech released too soon remains attached, becomes legible, and returns to the speaker as an object of reckoning.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later civic sequence supplies a scaled-up cascade: abundance releases its possessors, they breach a containing boundary, the uttered determination becomes binding, and demolition follows. This activates the focus call as a social trigger-chain in which what feels like available good can loosen restraint and mature into collective harm.

activation_trace.role: Successive falling provides the focus-side template for a multi-stage collapse.
A released spark supplies the small ignition that can become systemic damage.
Expansive luxury that releases its possessor supplies the permissive pressure at the start of the civic chain.
A ripe date exiting its peel supplies a concrete image of actors breaching containment.
Binding necessity supplies the transition from breach to an outcome that has become due.
An uttered saying supplies the speech-event that is realized within the chain.
Root-and-branch destruction supplies the terminal state of the propagated sequence.

structural_cues: Verse 17:16 is a tightly linked verbal chain: intention, command, affluent transgression, the word becoming due, and repeated-form destruction.
The focus itself places the call before the characterization of haste, allowing speech to be tested as an initiating act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a city-scale causal sequence and focus branches of cascading fall and spark; I map that sequence onto the individual call as a possible social amplification path. The materially live alternative is that 17:16 concerns collective judgment only and does not explain how a petition causes harm.

changed_reading.before: A rash request primarily endangers the individual caller.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the call can model a civic ignition: desired abundance releases restraint, boundary breach makes a word binding, and the resulting evil propagates beyond the original caller.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context weakens any simple claim that calling mechanically produces its object. Both temporal orientations receive continuing extension from a gift not barred, while recipients and later degrees remain differentiated. The focus call operates inside a larger allocation rather than functioning as an executable command.

activation_trace.role: Calling supplies the petition whose causal authority is being qualified.
Connected increase that supports another supplies an ongoing source beyond the caller's utterance.
Giving and handing over place receipt on the donor side rather than under unilateral human control.
The negated image of prohibition marks the breadth of giving without making every request determinative.
Rank and excellence supply qualitative differentiation within what is given.
Partition into portions prevents the field of recipients from collapsing into one undifferentiated outcome.
Stepwise degrees supply an ordered scale that immediate yes-or-no petition does not capture.

structural_cues: Verse 17:20 repeats 'these and these' under one source of extension, then denies that the gift is barred.
Verse 17:21 immediately commands comparison and describes differential degrees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continued giving to both groups and differentiated degrees; I infer that petition is not a sufficient cause of allotment. A live alternative is that broad giving and effective prayer coexist, so the context may qualify only the caller's control rather than the call's efficacy.

changed_reading.before: The hasty call itself sets the harmful outcome in motion.
changed_reading.after: That causal reading must be qualified: the call reveals misvaluation and may initiate conduct, but receipt remains part of a broader, graded distribution not commanded by the utterance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the split mapped root's image of shaking a measure and the rare image of setting something down before its vessel as a material analogy for prayer. It remains anchored in the repeated call and final haste predicate, whose branches explicitly supply those operations. Downstream prose should mark it as a container-and-capacity model, not as the lexical meaning of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated call supplies the forcing motion, while the final haste term supplies a premature order of placement.

activation_trace.role: Shaking a measure or vessel until it packs full supplies the image of demand forcing immediate capacity.
Putting something down before its vessel supplies the exact material reversal of receiving before readiness.
Beneficial good supplies the quality criterion displaced when filling now becomes the sole objective.

changed_reading.before: The caller asks too quickly for a wrongly valued object.
changed_reading.after: The caller tries to shake reality full and receive before a fitting vessel exists; evil and good collapse into the single metric of immediate filling.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates exchange and equivalence branches from the non-dominant mapped root behind the focus evil root. It remains anchored in the explicit comparison between evil and good and in the branch-resolved split supplied by the packet. Downstream prose should present it as an economic analogy for evaluative error, never as a replacement translation of the evil term.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places evil and good in a grammatical comparison under the same repeated calling act.

activation_trace.role: Exchange between buying and selling supplies a transaction model for how the caller takes harm as a desired return.
Matching and equivalence supply the mispricing operation implicit in treating evil like good.
Choosing the better option supplies the valuation decision that the hasty exchange gets wrong.
Premature advancement explains why equivalence is accepted before long-term value is known.

changed_reading.before: The human confuses two opposed objects of prayer.
changed_reading.after: The human performs a rushed valuation exchange, accepting harm as though it were an equivalent return for good.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a branch image of sharp, unrestrained flight to the neck-bound object and open book in 17:13. It remains anchored in the focus's voiced call and haste, and the context explicitly binds, locates, and unfolds the flying object. Downstream prose should qualify this as a material metaphor for released speech and accountability; the packet does not state that the attached bird is specifically a spoken petition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A hasty voiced call can be imaged as leaving quickly, while the following human-centered scene denies that what leaves is thereby detached.

activation_trace.role: Voiced calling supplies the speech-event that appears to leave the speaker.
Rapid advancement supplies the release velocity of the utterance.
Sharp, rash, unbound motion supplies the flight-image for speech sent out before reflection.
Affixing by obligation reverses the apparent escape of the flying act.
The neck supplies a bodily point of attachment to the same human agent.
A written object spread open supplies eventual exposure of the once-flying act.

changed_reading.before: The hasty word departs and its danger lies only in what it immediately triggers.
changed_reading.after: The word flies out but does not escape its speaker: it remains tethered to the human and can later be unfolded as accountable trace.

strongest_changes: The return sequence in 17:4-8 turns a one-way hasty utterance into a recursive, self-directed consequence.
The immediate-versus-later contrast in 17:10 and 17:18-19 makes haste a value horizon that mistakes speed of arrival for goodness.
Shown signs, temporal reckoning, and the attached open account make the focus error both epistemically premature and durably inspectable.
summary.what_was_special: The context reuses the focus human and haste roots while surrounding them with recurrence, visibility, accounting, selective acceleration, and graded giving. Split root inventories also preserve material models of forced filling and mispriced exchange without requiring those models to displace the direct moral reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus call may be literal petition, curse, wish, or a broader class of impulsive speech.
The transfer from collective recurrence and civic destruction to an individual call remains abductive.
The split-root container, exchange, and flight images are branch-resolved but should bear less interpretive weight than the direct temporal recurrence.
